name: Kimodo
description: Text in, VRM Animation out: describe the motion — walk, wave, sit down, dance — and Kimodo generates a .vrma you can play on any VRM avatar.
overview: Kimodo (NVIDIA) is a text-driven motion diffusion model trained on the SOMA skeleton: it turns a written description into human motion, keeping the feet planted and returning motion in a Y-up, meter-scale T-pose frame that already matches the VRM humanoid. Write the motion as one or more sentences: each sentence becomes a segment of the clip, and the segments are generated in order and stitched with short blended transitions.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.label: Motion Prompt
parameters.defaultValue: A person walks forward at a steady pace. Then they stop and wave with their right hand.
parameters.description: What the character does. Each sentence becomes its own segment, generated in order and stitched together.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.label: Duration (seconds)
parameters.description: Length of each segment, in seconds.

parameters.name: diffusion_steps
parameters.label: Diffusion Steps
parameters.description: DDIM denoising steps; more is slower and cleaner.

parameters.name: model
parameters.label: Model
parameters.description: Kimodo checkpoint (kimodo-soma-rp resolves to the newest installed version).
